text:
Nina G: quick thought propose a small, explicit pin metadata subset: `mode`, `soft_expire_s`, `hard_expire_ts`, `rollback_to`. Keep it compact so clients can copy easily.

Omar V: +1. define allowed `mode` values? how do they affect runtime?

Nina G: draft: `mode` in ["sticky", "trial", "transient"]. semantics: sticky = manual/manual-unless-override; trial = short-lived canary (auto rollback hint set); transient = short-lived, auto-evict eligible. `soft_expire_s` marks stale transition; `hard_expire_ts` is final eviction time.

Clara Z: conflict resolution idea: three-step tie-breaker: override flag (RBAC) > mode priority (sticky>trial>transient) > last-write. record `resolved_by` and `conflict_count` in audit.

Omar V: storage notes: composite index `(tenant, model, hard_expire_ts)` to drive eviction sweeps. keep `rollback_to` opaque. and runtime should maintain a small LRU cache of active pins to avoid DB hits on hot routes.

infra-bot: estimate: +50 bytes/pin avg, active pins ~500k => ~25MB. backfill ~6M writes. suggest backfill window 72h to smooth IO.

Clara Z: telemetry: counters `pin.create`, `pin.update`, `pin.stale_mark`, `pin.evict_soft`, `pin.evict_hard`, `pin.conflict`. add alert when `pin.conflict` rate > 3x baseline for 30m.

Nina G: API example for clarity:
```
PATCH /v1/pins/{id}
{
  "mode": "trial",
  "soft_expire_s": 3600,
  "hard_expire_ts": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
  "rollback_to": "variant:2026-03-20-v1",
  "note": "10% canary for ranking-v2"
}
```

Omar V: runtime behavior: when `soft_expire_s` reached mark pin `stale=true` and emit trace span. continue serving until `hard_expire_ts` unless admin `force_evict`. also auto-populate `rollback_to` at trial creation time.

Clara Z: security: `note` must be size-limited (256 chars) and non-indexed. `rollback_to` only opaque ids. RBAC required for overrides; log actor and auth method.

Nina G: migration plan: 1) add nullable fields, 2) deploy control plane to accept fields, 3) gradual backfill, 4) enable mode-priority conflict resolution behind flag for 14 days, 5) flip. owners: Nina(schema+migration), Omar(runtime+indexes), Clara(telemetry+RBAC).

audit-bot: created task PIN-12021 with checklist for schema, ops-runbook, telemetry, RBAC.

Nina G: will open the PR with enums and schema docs. thanks folks. :sparkles:
